cars.variant: The Machine 390 four-speed, optional 3.91 limited-slip — February 1970 road-test reference
cars.specification_market: Steve Kelly’s February 1970 Hot Rod road-test configuration, not every Machine’s standard equipment. The tested optional 3.91 limited-slip differs from the standard 3.54 axle. Stock camshaft retained; dealer performance cam, richer carburetion, ignition advance and stiffer-shock suggestions are excluded. Prior worn test-car bushings are not a factory feature. No quarter-mile, weight, production count or modern hp standard is inferred; colours, gearbox options and dealer upgrades add no counts.
cars.summary: The Machine captures AMC’s distinctive contribution to the American muscle-car era: a dedicated 390 V8 road package with revised induction/exhaust, a functional fresh-air hood and upgraded chassis equipment. Its historical sporting identity earns one original Rebel family entry. The contemporary test’s excellent-brake assessment is retained alongside criticism of handling, shift quality and presentation; period significance does not imply flawless execution.

Its historical sporting identity earns one original Rebel family entry. The contemporary test’s excellent-brake assessment is retained alongside criticism of handling, shift quality and presentation; period significance does not imply flawless execution.

cars.variant: GTS 340 TorqueFlite, 3.55 Sure-Grip — April 1968 road-test reference
cars.specification_market: Steve Kelly’s April 1968 Hot Rod test, 340 automatic with optional 3.55 Sure-Grip. Automatic cam differs from manual; no manual cam figures are transferred. Its quicker drag runs removed the air-filter element/top and are not stock performance. Timing/linkage tuning suggestions, 383 weight/tune, competition Hemi equipment, later Swinger variants and cosmetic editions are excluded. Native hp/lb-ft retained without invented modern net/gross standard.
cars.summary: The Dart GTS established a potent compact-muscle formula around Chrysler’s 340 V8, with strong straight-line performance and capable road manners in a smaller package. A contemporary extended test praised its handling and braking while identifying fuel-starvation and seating faults. One original US Dart family is admitted for that sporting identity; big-block options, Swinger names, Hemi competition cars and paint do not add counts.

A contemporary extended test praised its handling and braking while identifying fuel-starvation and seating faults. One original US Dart family is admitted for that sporting identity; big-block options, Swinger names, Hemi competition cars and paint do not add counts.
